findings_not_filed.policy: 5d never ran, so NOTHING was filed and no tracker comment was posted. All findings below are evidenced and persisted locally, awaiting a human decision.
in_scope_medium: A1 — the active-filter chip falls back to the raw English machine term in the zero-match state. de-DE: chip reads 'In Bearbeitung'; drive the result set to zero and the SAME chip flips to 'Processing' on an otherwise fully German page. REVERSIBLE (restoring rows flips it back) which is the control confirming the mechanism: label = statusOptions.find(o => o.name === status)?.label ?? status, and statusOptions is facet-derived, hence empty exactly when totalCount is 0. TWO routes, the second ordinary: a search term matching nothing while a status filter is active. INVISIBLE on en-US, present on all 12 other locales. Case SR-CO-032. Would file as a Sub-task.

A2 — the drawer preset selector goes stale against the applied range and the drawer cannot correct it. Preset 'Letzter Monat' -> close ONLY the Beginn chip -> selector still reads 'Letzter Monat' while the query is open-ended createddate:[TO "2026-09-03T21:59:59.999Z"]. Aggravating: a non-custom preset HIDES the Start/End inputs, so the chip row is the only honest surface. Mechanism: the watch on props.applied resets selectedRange only when BOTH dates are falsy. Case SR-CO-034. Would file as a Sub-task.
a11y_standalone_never_blocks: B1 — all six chip close buttons share one accessible name, the literal 'Close chip' / 'Chip schließen'. Triple-confirmed: rendered attribute, Chromium AX tree, axe accessibleTextVirtual. closeButtonAriaLabel is passed at ZERO call sites in all of client-app. WCAG 2.4.6/4.1.2. Medium. UI-kit default is PRE-EXISTING; a247b3ab is the first place it produces a collision.

B2 — 'Reset filters' destroys the focused element; document.activeElement becomes body, dumping a keyboard user to the top of the tab order. Reproduces on BOTH routes. WCAG 2.4.3. Medium. NEW in a247b3ab. Same CLASS as the open VCST-5869 (drawer 'focus never returns') — link as a sibling, do not duplicate; control and mechanism differ.
out_of_scope_incidental_medium: C1 — an unparseable date disables Apply with NO message. de-DE inputs are DD.MM.YYYY; '12.31.2030' leaves Anwenden dead and no error renders. Source-confirmed: showRangeError fires only for start-after-end, while isRangeValid ALSO requires each date to parse — so a malformed date blocks Apply on a predicate the message does not cover. The invalid_range string exists in all 13 locales and is never reached. Lines 213-217 are in NO hunk of a247b3ab => PRE-EXISTING, newly discovered.

C2 — language-selector options are prefixed with the ACTIVE language, and two options collide byte-for-byte: under de-DE both en-GB and en-US compute to 'Deutsch (Deutschland) English', indistinguishable to a screen reader and to automation. Not a PR #2444 surface.
below_floor_low_not_filed: D1 — drawer option labels clip at 375px; the full value has no title/aria-label/aria-describedby, and a vc-tooltip wrapper IS present in the markup but renders nothing because the checkbox input overlays the row and intercepts pointer events. Recoverable only via the accessible name. NO clipping at 1920px and the count badge stays fully visible in every case; the four current org names diverge BEFORE the cut point, so no two options are ambiguous today — latent, not live. Low/P3 => does not file.

D2 — the accessible name has no separator node: axe accname computes 'New56' while Chromium's AX tree reports 'New 56'. The accname spec does not guarantee the space, so non-Chromium AT may announce the run-on form. Firefox/WebKit UNVERIFIED and screen-reader output is manual-only. Low, explicitly unconfirmed.

D3 — BL-UI-006 mobile 44x44 guidance: chip closes are 28x28 with a minimum close-to-close edge gap of exactly 8.0px. AA-binding 2.5.8 PASSES at 28px via the spacing exception, and 28px is the UI-kit vc-chip md value. Graded Low deliberately rather than inflated into a blocker.
